integrity: All result formulas are asserted for stated quantifiers; the probability representation has known prior art, only its sharp fixed-spectrum QR pivot-regret orientation maximization is assessed for originality. Numerical checks supplement a complete analytic derivation. External priority verification has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Two real input columns, rank two, exactly two independent real Gaussian sketch rows, exact arithmetic, and expected regret in the squared first pivot norm only; no conclusion for full QR stability, alternative sketch sizes, or later pivots.
title: A golden-ratio orientation transition for Gaussian-sketched QR pivot regret
